name: Surendranagar

queries.query: Surendranagar Gujarat official cadastral parcel map GIS public viewer API
queries.result: First-party results identified the Government of Gujarat District Surendranagar land-record service, its AnyRoR land-record portal, Surendranagar Municipal Corporation maps, and the official Gujarat State GIS/BharatMaps portal. The district page states that cadastral survey was completed statewide in 1960 and records are updated through taluka e-Dhara centers.

queries.query: સુરેન્દ્રનગર જમીન નકશો કેડસ્ટ્રલ સત્તાવાર GIS પાર્સલ
queries.result: First-party discovery returned the Gujarati-linked Government of Gujarat district land-record page and official Gujarat GIS references. The results support local land-record custody and administrative mapping, but no anonymous Surendranagar parcel ID-plus-geometry response or public parcel schema was obtained.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Gujarati first-party web discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified anonymous GET attempts. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS disablement was used.

portalsFound.observation: Official District Surendranagar, Government of Gujarat page. It identifies statewide cadastral survey, computerized land records, mutation processing through taluka e-Dhara centers, and the AnyRoR portal. This evidences a local/district land-record custodian, not an open parcel feature API.

Official Gujarat land-record portal linked by the district administration. The public request did not complete within the bounded attempt, so viewer configuration, service route, parcel schema and geometry were not verified.

Official Surendranagar Municipal Corporation maps page. It provides contour, inundation and municipal/SWUDA boundary maps; its published maps are contextual administrative or thematic maps, not a verified parcel polygon service.
Official Gujarat State GIS portal powered by BharatMaps. Discovery exposed administrative GIS functionality, but the current map request returned no usable configuration or parcel layer response.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds without a response. No HTML, JavaScript configuration, public API route, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained. This is a route failure, not evidence of citywide absence.

Anonymous request did not return usable content within the bounded attempt; web discovery also reported a 502 fetch failure. No parcel service configuration, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained.
Official municipal maps page loaded. The listed downloads are contour, inundation and boundary/SWUDA maps; no parcel feature endpoint or safe parcel geometry was exposed. No geometry retained.

A second direct request path was not attempted with certificate verification disabled: the environment reported a self-signed certificate-chain error on an attempted request, and no source-specific TLS exception was authorized. TLS was not bypassed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gujarat district land-record custody, the Gujarat AnyRoR portal, Surendranagar Municipal Corporation public maps, and the Gujarat State GIS/BharatMaps portal.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local/district land-record custody and municipal map presence only; no open Surendranagar parcel geometry coverage, public service schema or bounded ID-plus-geometry response verified.

remainingUncertainty: AnyRoR and State GIS current JavaScript/configuration, public API route, Surendranagar urban/taluka unit identifiers, parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity, update currency and citywide completeness remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A timeout, map extent miss, TLS failure or unusable UI is not evidence of cadastral absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the current official Gujarat viewer through an available public route and request only bounded anonymous native ID-plus-geometry data for Surendranagar. Serial reviewer qualification remains required; runtime readiness stays held.
